groups.name: Flat 5B
groups.about: Four flatmates sharing rent, bills, groceries and nights out. Rent is paid weekly.

say: Ana has the big room, so she pays double what each of the others pays on rent.

Dan doesn’t use any of the subscriptions, keep him off them.
Leave Dan out of the streaming subscriptions.
Dan never signed up for these subscriptions, he shouldn’t pay.
